$comment: CANONICAL integration-root registry (PR-B, Dev Execution Model v1.4 §12). The SINGLE source of truth for which Nx projects run the ARAMO_RUN_INTEGRATION lane. Every runner (ci-integration.sh, prepush.ts, package.json tests:integration) DERIVES from this file — no runner may embed its own root list or --root chain. The default-deny guard (ci/scripts/check-integration-roots.ts) proves this file covers every integration-bearing project. Counts are NEVER frozen here or in any runner; they are derived at runtime. Ordering is deterministic (ascending) and guard-enforced.
